Q.name: Decimate
Q.title: Template:Data Darius/Decimate
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Decimate|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Darius
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Decimate.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Darius}} briefly winds up to spin his axe in a circle while {{tip|ghosted}}, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
|blurb2       = When '''Darius''' hits a {{tip|champion}} with the blade, he applies a {{ai|Hemorrhage|Darius}} stack and {{tip|heals}} based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}, multiplied by the number of champions hit up to 3.
|blurb3       = Enemies hit by the handle receive reduced damage and do not gain a ''{{ai|Hemorrhage|Darius}}'' stack.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} for 1 second and hefts his axe for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, afterward swinging it around himself to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. Enemies within the inner radius take 35% damage.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage (Blade)|{{ap|50 to 170}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100 to 140}}% AD)}}|Reduced Damage (Handle)|{{ap|50*0.35 to 170*0.35}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.35 to 140*0.35}}% AD)}}}}
|description2 = Against champions and large monsters hit, '''Darius''' {{tip|heal|heals}} for {{as|{{sti|health|{{pp|changedisplay=true|type=number of targets hit by the outer radius|key=%|17 to 51 for 3|1;2;3+|formula=17% * number of targets hit. ''This is capped at 3 enemies.''}} of his '''missing''' health}}}}. Enemies hit by the inner radius do not refresh the duration of or gain a stack of ''{{ai|Hemorrhage|Darius}}''.
|description3 = '''''Darius''' can move during Decimate, but is unable to declare basic attacks or cast {{ai|Apprehend|Darius}} or {{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}}.''

|inner radius = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 240
|cooldown     = {{ap|9 to 5}}

|cast time    = none
|cost         = {{ap|25 to 45}}
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    =

* ''Decimate'' will cancel if '''Darius''' enters {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} or uses {{si|Dash}} during the delay.

W.name: Crippling Strike
W.title: Template:Data Darius/Crippling Strike
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Crippling Strike|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Darius
|skill        = W
|icon         = Crippling Strike.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Darius}} next {{tip|basic attack}} within a few seconds deals increased {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} the target.
|blurb2       = If the empowered attack kills the target, the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reduced}} and the {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 90% for 1 second. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|40 to 60}}% AD}}}}
|description2 = If this attack kills the target, half of ''Crippling Strike's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced and its {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
|description3 = ''Crippling Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Darius' ''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = 5
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 40
|costtype     = mana
|cast time    = none 
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies, Structures
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = Special
|projectile   = 
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* ''Crippling Strike'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} but will also trigger {{tip|spell effects}} by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
** This includes the {{tip|basic attack}} itself.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} will negate all effects of ''Crippling Strike'', including the damage of the basic attack itself.{{bug|2}}
* The attack's animation can be cancelled by casting {{ai|Decimate|Darius}}, but the attack will still land.
* The cooldown reduction and mana refund will not trigger when killing [[jungle plants]].
}}

E.name: Apprehend
E.title: Template:Data Darius/Apprehend
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Apprehend|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Darius
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Darius}} gains {{as|{{sti|armor penetration}}}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' sweeps in a cone in the target direction, {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} enemies hit towards him.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Darius''' gains {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor penetration}}}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Armor Penetration|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
|icon2        = Apprehend.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' sweeps his axe in a cone in the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second while {{tip|airborne|pulling}} enemies hit towards him. Upon arrival, they rebound {{tt|150|Estimated}} units off of him, remaining {{tip|airborne}} and becoming {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% for 1 second.
|description3 = '''''Darius''' is unable to move or cast {{ai|Decimate|Darius}} or {{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after Apprehend's cast time.''
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 535
|angle        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 50{{degree}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|26 to 16}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = {{ap|70 to 30}}
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = False
|notes        = 
* Enemies hit by ''Apprehend'' will quickly be dragged to '''Darius''' before rebounding over a longer period.
** The {{tip|slow}} duration starts as soon as the target rebounds off of '''Darius'''<!-- , meaning 50% {{tip|Tenacity}} will leave the target not slowed at all after the {{tip|airborne}} ends.
** This is disregarding stat update timing, which means that the target's movement speed may still be reduced for up-to {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the slow ends-->.
** {{pending for test}}: The rebound location is determined when the target reaches '''Darius' '''location.
** The rebound's forced movement's duration is roughly {{fd|0.5}} seconds, finishing before the {{tip|airborne}} duration ends.
** {{pending for test}}: There is no {{tip|stun}} applied for the same duration of the {{tip|airborne}}, meaning {{tip|brittle}} cannot extend the disable duration. It will not increase the {{tip|slow}} duration in most situations because of the negative tenacity falling off before the slow is applied.
* After the pull, '''Darius''' will attempt to basic attack the closest pulled target, prioritizing enemy champions.
* The armor penetration {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other forms of [[Armor_penetration#Percentage_armor_penetration|percentage armor penetration]].
{{Effect at cast time end}}
{{ct|cast|spells=true,false,false,false,false}}
}}

R.name: Noxian Guillotine
R.title: Template:Data Darius/Noxian Guillotine
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Noxian Guillotine|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Darius
|skill        = R
|icon         = Noxian Guillotine.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Darius}} {{tip|lunge|leaps}} to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing {{as|true damage}} based on the target's current ''{{ai|Hemorrhage|Darius}}'' stacks.
|blurb2       = If the target dies very briefly afterwards, ''Noxian Guillotine's'' cooldown is temporarily {{sti|ah|reset}}, and nearby {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} are {{tip|fear|feared}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
|blurb4       = At max rank, ''Noxian Guillotine'' permanently resets its cooldown if the target dies very briefly afterwards.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' attempts to execute the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|lunge|leaping}} towards them to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}, increased by {{pp|type=target's [[File:Hemorrhage.png|20px]] Hemorrhage stacks|key=%|0 to 100 by 20|0 to 5|formula=20% for every Hemorrhage stack the target has, capped at 100% at 5 stacks}}, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds from the start of the cast time.
|leveling     = {{st|True Damage|{{ap|125 to 375}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Bonus Damage Per Stack|{{ap|125*0.2 to 375*0.2}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum True Damage|{{ap|125*2 to 375*2}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = If the target dies within {{fd|0.15}} seconds after being hit by ''Noxian Guillotine'', '''Darius''' {{tip|fear|fears}} nearby {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually {{tip|slow|slowed}} by up to 99% over the duration. He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.
|description3 = At rank 3, ''Noxian Guillotine'' has no {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} and recast timer.
|description4 = '''''Darius''' is unable to cast {{ai|Decimate|Darius}} or {{ai|Apprehend|Darius}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Noxian Guillotine's cast time.''
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 475
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 80}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|100|100|0}}
|costtype     = mana
|cast time = {{fd|0.3667}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = True
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spell
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = False
|callforhelp  = True
|notes        = 
* ''Noxian Guillotine's'' cooldown after the recast or recast window is calculated by taking the values at the end, and using this formula: (''Noxian Guillotine's'' Cooldown - time since first cast){{times}}100{{divided by}}(100 + {{sti|AH}}).
* ''Noxian Guillotine'' applies {{ai|Hemorrhage|Darius}} after the damage.
* '''Darius''' will only leap towards the target if it is at range, or leap backwards if it is very close.
** This leap can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, '''Darius''' will still hit the target.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jE6vb4IqvC8]
** The ability is disabled while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}} even if '''Darius''' is in the range in which he does not leap.
* ''Noxian Guillotine'' will not reset nor trigger {{ai|Hemorrhage 2|Darius|Noxian Might}} if used to kill a {{tip|clone}} or a target protected by {{tip|resurrection}}.
* ''Noxian Guillotine'' will reset but not trigger {{ai|Hemorrhage 2|Darius|Noxian Might}} if it finishes off a target that is in a {{tip|zombie state}}.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}
